scenarios.title: Customer Support Resolution Agent
scenarios.context: You are building a customer support agent for **Larkspur Outfitters**, an online retailer, using the Claude Agent SDK. The agent uses MCP tools: `get_customer`, `lookup_order`, `process_refund` and `escalate_to_human`. The goal is 80%+ first-contact resolution, with no refunds for unverified customers.

scenarios.title: Code Generation with Claude Code
scenarios.context: **Quillstone**, a 60-engineer SaaS company, uses Claude Code daily in a TypeScript monorepo (`apps/`, `packages/`, `infra/terraform`). A platform team maintains the shared configuration: CLAUDE.md files, `.claude/` commands, skills and rules. Engineers also keep personal preferences.

scenarios.title: Multi-Agent Research System
scenarios.context: **Meridian Analytics** builds market-research briefs with an Agent SDK coordinator. The coordinator delegates through the Task tool to four subagents: search, document analysis, synthesis and report. Every quantitative claim in a brief must cite its source.

scenarios.title: Developer Productivity with Claude
scenarios.context: **Halyard Systems** is building an internal developer assistant on the Claude Agent SDK. It answers questions about a 2-million-line Java/Python codebase and makes small changes. It uses the built-in tools (Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob) plus MCP servers for the issue tracker, wiki and deployment catalog.

scenarios.title: Claude Code for Continuous Integration
scenarios.context: **Brightwater Health** runs Claude Code in GitHub Actions to review pull requests, suggest missing tests and post PR comments on every push. Developers complain that the bot is noisy, but security and correctness findings must not be missed. A nightly job also summarises technical debt.

scenarios.title: Structured Data Extraction
scenarios.context: **Corvid Logistics** extracts fields from about 25,000 invoices, bills of lading and customs forms a week, in many layouts and languages, into JSON for its ERP. Malformed records are rejected, totals must reconcile, and uncertain records go to human review.
